audit_status.source_base: Hebrew source via Sefaria with source/English versification reconciliation; public-domain KJV familiar comparison
audit_status.review_note: Nehemiah 3 is a straightforward register of wall-builders with repeating formulae. Hebrew versification (38 verses) reconciles to KJV (32 verses) by combining material; vv. 33-38 (opposition/prayer) form the source bridge to chapter 4. Key challenges: proper names, gate/tower identifications, grammatical ambiguities in list markers, and ancient administrative divisions. No major textual variants in this chapter.

verses.restored: Then rose up Eliashib the high priest, he and his brothers the priests, and they built the gate of the sheep. They sanctified it and set up its doors; even unto the tower of Meah they sanctified it, unto the tower of Hananeel.

familiar.text: Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brethren the priests, and they builded the sheep gate; they sanctified it, and set up the doors of it; even unto the tower of Meah they sanctified it, unto the tower of Hananeel.

notes.title: Sanctified
notes.body: קִדְּשׁוּ (qiddšû): 'consecrated' or 'set apart.' Priestly act of ritual dedication precedes structural work.

modern.text: At the Sheep Gate, Eliashib the high priest and his fellow priests began rebuilding. They dedicated it and installed its doors. After building as far as the Tower of the Hundred and the Tower of Hananel, they dedicated the wall.

original.text: וַיָּ֡קָם אֶלְיָשִׁיב֩ הַכֹּהֵ֨ן הַגָּד֜וֹל וְאֶחָ֣יו הַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים וַיִּבְנוּ֙ אֶת שַׁ֣עַר הַצֹּ֔אן הֵ֣מָּה קִדְּשׁ֔וּהוּ וַֽיַּעֲמִ֖ידוּ דַּלְתֹתָ֑יו וְעַד מִגְדַּ֤ל הַמֵּאָה֙ קִדְּשׁ֔וּהוּ עַ֖ד מִגְדַּ֥ל חֲנַנְאֵֽל

verses.restored: And beside him built the men of Jericho. And beside him built Zaccur son of Imri.

familiar.text: And next unto him builded the men of Jericho. And next to them builded Zaccur the son of Imri.

modern.text: The men of Jericho built next to Eliashib, and Zaccur son of Imri built next to them.

original.text: וְעַל יָד֥וֹ בָנ֖וּ אַנְשֵׁ֣י יְרֵח֑וֹ וְעַל יָד֣וֹ בָנָ֔ה זַכּ֖וּר בֶּן אִמְרִֽי

verses.restored: And the fish gate did the sons of Hassenaah build; they raftered it and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars.

familiar.text: But the fish gate did the sons of Hassenaah build, who also laid the beams thereof, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.

modern.text: The Fish Gate was rebuilt by the sons of Hassenaah. They laid its beams and installed its doors, bolts, and bars.

original.text: וְאֵת֙ שַׁ֣עַר הַדָּגִ֔ים בָּנ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י הַסְּנָאָ֑ה הֵ֣מָּה קֵר֔וּהוּ וַֽיַּעֲמִ֨ידוּ֙ דַּלְתֹתָ֔יו מַנְעוּלָ֖יו וּבְרִיחָֽיו

verses.restored: And beside them strengthened Meremoth son of Urijah son of Hakkoz. And beside them strengthened Meshullam son of Berechiah son of Meshezabel. And beside them strengthened Zadok son of Baana.

familiar.text: And next unto them repaired Meremoth the son of Urijah, the son of Koz. And next unto them repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabeel. And next unto them repaired Zadok the son of Baana.

modern.text: Next to them, Meremoth son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz, made repairs. Next to him, Meshullam son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabel, made repairs; and next to him, Zadok son of Baana made repairs as well.

original.text: וְעַל יָדָ֣ם הֶחֱזִ֗יק מְרֵמ֤וֹת בֶּן אוּרִיָּה֙ בֶּן הַקּ֔וֹץ וְעַל יָדָ֣ם הֶחֱזִ֔יק מְשֻׁלָּ֥ם בֶּן בֶּרֶכְיָ֖ה בֶּן מְשֵׁיזַבְאֵ֑ל וְעַל יָדָ֣ם הֶֽחֱזִ֔יק צָד֖וֹק בֶּֽן בַּעֲנָֽא

verses.restored: And beside them the Tekoites strengthened; but their nobles would not put their necks to the work of their lords.

familiar.text: And next unto them the Tekoites repaired; but their nobles put not their necks to the work of their LORD.

notes.title: Nobles' refusal
notes.body: אַדִּֽירֵיהֶם (addîreyhem): 'their nobles/mightiest ones' deliberately withdraw their labor. Social inequality intrudes even upon collective reconstruction.

modern.text: Next to him, the Tekoites made repairs, but their nobles did not put their shoulders to the work under their supervisors.

original.text: וְעַל יָדָ֖ם הֶחֱזִ֣יקוּ הַתְּקוֹעִ֑ים וְאַדִּֽירֵיהֶם֙ לֹא הֵבִ֣יאוּ צַוָּרָ֔ם בַּעֲבֹדַ֖ת אֲדֹנֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: And the old gate strengthened Jehoiada son of Paseah and Meshullam son of Besodeiah; they raftered it and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars.

familiar.text: Moreover the old gate repaired Jehoiada the son of Paseah, and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah; they laid the beams thereof, and set up the doors thereof, and the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.

modern.text: The Jeshanah Gate was repaired by Joiada son of Paseah and Meshullam son of Besodeiah. They laid its beams and installed its doors, bolts, and bars.

original.text: וְאֵת֩ שַׁ֨עַר הַיְשָׁנָ֜ה הֶחֱזִ֗יקוּ יֽוֹיָדָע֙ בֶּן פָּסֵ֔חַ וּמְשֻׁלָּ֖ם בֶּן בְּסֽוֹדְיָ֑ה הֵ֣מָּה קֵר֔וּהוּ וַֽיַּעֲמִ֨ידוּ֙ דַּלְתֹתָ֔יו וּמַנְעֻלָ֖יו וּבְרִיחָֽיו

verses.restored: And beside them strengthened Melatiah the Gibeonite, and Jadon the Meronothite, men of Gibeon and of Mizpah, under the seat of the governor beyond the river.

familiar.text: And next unto them repaired Melatiah the Gibeonite, and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon, and of Mizpah, unto the throne of the governor on this side the river.

modern.text: Next to them, repairs were made by Melatiah the Gibeonite, Jadon the Meronothite, and the men of Gibeon and Mizpah, who were under the authority of the governor of the region west of the Euphrates.

original.text: וְעַל יָדָ֨ם הֶחֱזִ֜יק מְלַטְיָ֣ה הַגִּבְעֹנִ֗י וְיָדוֹן֙ הַמֵּרֹ֣נֹתִ֔י אַנְשֵׁ֥י גִבְע֖וֹן וְהַמִּצְפָּ֑ה לְכִסֵּ֕א פַּחַ֖ת עֵ֥בֶר הַנָּהָֽר

verses.restored: Upon his hand strengthened Uzziel son of Harhaiah, of the goldsmiths. And upon his hand strengthened Hananiah son of the apothecaries; and they left Jerusalem intact unto the broad wall.

familiar.text: Next unto him repaired Uzziel the son of Harhaiah, of the goldsmiths. Next unto him also repaired Hananiah the son of one of the apothecaries, and they fortified Jerusalem unto the broad wall.

modern.text: Next to them, Uzziel son of Harhaiah, one of the goldsmiths, made repairs, and next to him, Hananiah son of the perfumer made repairs. They fortified Jerusalem as far as the Broad Wall.

original.text: עַל יָד֣וֹ הֶחֱזִ֗יק עֻזִּיאֵ֤ל בֶּֽן חַרְהֲיָה֙ צֽוֹרְפִ֔ים וְעַל יָד֣וֹ הֶחֱזִ֔יק חֲנַנְיָ֖ה בֶּן הָרַקָּחִ֑ים וַיַּֽעַזְבוּ֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם עַ֖ד הַחוֹמָ֥ה הָרְחָבָֽה

verses.restored: And beside them strengthened Rephaiah son of Hur, ruler of the half-district of Jerusalem.

familiar.text: And next unto them repaired Rephaiah the son of Hur, the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem.

modern.text: Next to them, Rephaiah son of Hur, ruler of a half-district of Jerusalem, made repairs;

original.text: וְעַל יָדָ֤ם הֶחֱזִיק֙ רְפָיָ֣ה בֶן ח֔וּר שַׂ֕ר חֲצִ֖י פֶּ֥לֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם

verses.restored: And beside them strengthened Jedaiah son of Harumaph, even over against his house. And beside him strengthened Hattush son of Hashabniah.

familiar.text: And next unto them repaired Jedaiah the son of Harumaph, even over against his house. And next unto him repaired Hattush the son of Hashabniah.

modern.text: next to him, Jedaiah son of Harumaph made repairs across from his house; and next to him, Hattush son of Hashabneiah made repairs.

original.text: וְעַל יָדָ֧ם הֶחֱזִ֛יק יְדָיָ֥ה בֶן חֲרוּמַ֖ף וְנֶ֣גֶד בֵּית֑וֹ וְעַל יָד֣וֹ הֶחֱזִ֔יק חַטּ֖וּשׁ בֶּן חֲשַׁבְנְיָֽה

verses.restored: A second measure Malchijah son of Harim and Hashub son of Pahathmoab strengthened, and the tower of the furnaces.

familiar.text: Malchijah the son of Harim, and Hashub the son of Pahathmoab, repaired the other piece, and the tower of the furnaces.

notes.title: Second measure
notes.body: מִדָּה שֵׁנִית: 'another portion' or 'second measure.' Suggests the wall is divided into overlapping assignments or work is doubled back.

modern.text: Malchijah son of Harim and Hasshub son of Pahath-moab repaired another section, as well as the Tower of the Ovens.

original.text: מִדָּ֣ה שֵׁנִ֗ית הֶחֱזִיק֙ מַלְכִּיָּ֣ה בֶן חָרִ֔ם וְחַשּׁ֖וּב בֶּן פַּחַ֣ת מוֹאָ֑ב וְאֵ֖ת מִגְדַּ֥ל הַתַּנּוּרִֽים

verses.restored: And beside him strengthened Shallum son of Hallohesh, ruler of the half-district of Jerusalem, he and his daughters.

familiar.text: And next unto him repaired Shallum the son of Halohesh, the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem, he and his daughters.

modern.text: And next to them, Shallum son of Hallohesh, ruler of the other half-district of Jerusalem, made repairs, with the help of his daughters.

original.text: וְעַל יָד֣וֹ הֶחֱזִ֗יק שַׁלּוּם֙ בֶּן הַלּוֹחֵ֔שׁ שַׂ֕ר חֲצִ֖י פֶּ֣לֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם ה֖וּא וּבְנוֹתָֽיו

verses.restored: The valley gate strengthened Hanun and the inhabitants of Zanoah; they built it and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars, and a thousand cubits upon the wall unto the dung gate.

familiar.text: The valley gate repaired Hanun, and the inhabitants of Zanoah; they built it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof, and a thousand cubits on the wall unto the dung gate.

modern.text: The Valley Gate was repaired by Hanun and the residents of Zanoah. They rebuilt it, installed its doors, bolts, and bars, and repaired a thousand cubits of the wall as far as the Dung Gate.

original.text: אֵת֩ שַׁ֨עַר הַגַּ֜יְא הֶחֱזִ֣יק חָנוּן֮ וְיֹשְׁבֵ֣י זָנוֹחַ֒ הֵ֣מָּה בָנ֔וּהוּ וַֽיַּעֲמִ֨ידוּ֙ דַּלְתֹתָ֔יו מַנְעֻלָ֖יו וּבְרִיחָ֑יו וְאֶ֤לֶף אַמָּה֙ בַּחוֹמָ֔ה עַ֖ד שַׁ֥עַר הָשֲׁפֽוֹת

verses.restored: And the dung gate strengthened Malchijah son of Rechab, ruler of the district of Beth-haccerem; he built it and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars.

familiar.text: But the dung gate repaired Malchiah the son of Rechab, the ruler of part of Bethhaccerem; he built it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.

modern.text: The Dung Gate was repaired by Malchijah son of Rechab, ruler of the district of Beth-haccherem. He rebuilt it and installed its doors, bolts, and bars.

original.text: וְאֵ֣ת שַׁ֣עַר הָאַשְׁפּ֗וֹת הֶחֱזִיק֙ מַלְכִּיָּ֣ה בֶן רֵכָ֔ב שַׂ֖ר פֶּ֣לֶךְ בֵּית הַכָּ֑רֶם ה֣וּא יִבְנֶ֔נּוּ וְיַעֲמִיד֙ דַּלְתֹתָ֔יו מַנְעֻלָ֖יו וּבְרִיחָֽיו

verses.restored: And the gate of the fountain strengthened Shallun son of Col-hozeh, ruler of the district of Mizpah; he built it and tiled it and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars, and the wall of the pool of the shelach by the king's garden, and unto the stairs that go down from the city of David.

familiar.text: But the gate of the fountain repaired Shallun the son of Colhozeh, the ruler of part of Mizpah; he built it, and covered it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof, and the wall of the pool of Siloah by the king’s garden, and unto the stairs that go down from the city of David.

notes.title: Tiled / covered
notes.body: ויטללנו or ויעמידו (variant): 'tiled' or 'set up'—early witnesses differ on the precise treatment of the gate structure.

modern.text: The Fountain Gate was repaired by Shallun son of Col-hozeh, ruler of the district of Mizpah. He rebuilt it, roofed it, and installed its doors, bolts, and bars. He also repaired the wall of the Pool of Shelah near the king’s garden, as far as the stairs that descend from the City of David.

original.text: וְאֵת֩ שַׁ֨עַר הָעַ֜יִן הֶ֠חֱזִיק שַׁלּ֣וּן בֶּן כָּל חֹזֶה֮ שַׂ֣ר פֶּ֣לֶךְ הַמִּצְפָּה֒ ה֤וּא יִבְנֶ֨נּוּ֙ וִיטַֽלְלֶ֔נּוּ ויעמידו דַּלְתֹתָ֔יו מַנְעֻלָ֖יו וּבְרִיחָ֑יו וְ֠אֵת חוֹמַ֞ת בְּרֵכַ֤ת הַשֶּׁ֨לַח֙ לְגַן הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וְעַד הַֽמַּעֲל֔וֹת הַיּוֹרְד֖וֹת מֵעִ֥יר דָּוִֽיד

verses.restored: After him strengthened Nehemiah son of Azbuk, ruler of the half-district of Beth-zur, unto the place over against the tombs of David, and unto the pool that was made, and unto the house of the mighty.

familiar.text: After him repaired Nehemiah the son of Azbuk, the ruler of the half part of Bethzur, unto the place over against the sepulchres of David, and to the pool that was made, and unto the house of the mighty.

modern.text: Beyond him, Nehemiah son of Azbuk, ruler of a half-district of Beth-zur, made repairs up to a point opposite the tombs of David, as far as the artificial pool and the House of the Mighty.

original.text: אַחֲרָ֤יו הֶחֱזִיק֙ נְחֶמְיָ֣ה בֶן עַזְבּ֔וּק שַׂ֕ר חֲצִ֖י פֶּ֣לֶךְ בֵּֽית צ֑וּר עַד נֶ֨גֶד֙ קִבְרֵ֣י דָוִ֔יד וְעַד הַבְּרֵכָה֙ הָעֲשׂוּיָ֔ה וְעַ֖ד בֵּ֥ית הַגִּבֹּרִֽים

verses.restored: After him strengthened the Levites, Rehum son of Bani. Next unto him strengthened Hashabiah, ruler of the half-district of Keilah, in his portion.

familiar.text: After him repaired the Levites, Rehum the son of Bani. Next unto him repaired Hashabiah, the ruler of the half part of Keilah, in his part.

modern.text: Next to him, the Levites made repairs under Rehum son of Bani, and next to him, Hashabiah, ruler of a half-district of Keilah, made repairs for his district.

original.text: אַחֲרָ֛יו הֶחֱזִ֥יקוּ הַלְוִיִּ֖ם רְח֣וּם בֶּן בָּנִ֑י עַל יָד֣וֹ הֶחֱזִ֗יק חֲשַׁבְיָ֛ה שַׂר חֲצִי פֶ֥לֶךְ קְעִילָ֖ה לְפִלְכּֽוֹ

verses.restored: After him strengthened their brothers, Bavai son of Henadad, ruler of the half-district of Keilah.

familiar.text: After him repaired their brethren, Bavai the son of Henadad, the ruler of the half part of Keilah.

modern.text: Next to him, their countrymen made repairs under Binnui son of Henadad, ruler of the other half-district of Keilah.

original.text: אַחֲרָיו֙ הֶחֱזִ֣יקוּ אֲחֵיהֶ֔ם בַּוַּ֖י בֶּן חֵנָדָ֑ד שַׂ֕ר חֲצִ֖י פֶּ֥לֶךְ קְעִילָֽה

verses.restored: And next to him strengthened Ezer son of Jeshua, ruler of Mizpah, a second measure over against the ascent to the armory at the corner.

familiar.text: And next to him repaired Ezer the son of Jeshua, the ruler of Mizpah, another piece over against the going up to the armoury at the turning of the wall.

modern.text: And next to him, Ezer son of Jeshua, ruler of Mizpah, repaired another section opposite the Ascent to the Armory, near the angle in the wall.

original.text: וַיְחַזֵּ֨ק עַל יָד֜וֹ עֵ֧זֶר בֶּן יֵשׁ֛וּעַ שַׂ֥ר הַמִּצְפָּ֖ה מִדָּ֣ה שֵׁנִ֑ית מִנֶּ֕גֶד עֲלֹ֥ת הַנֶּ֖שֶׁק הַמִּקְצֹֽעַ

verses.restored: After him eagerly strengthened Baruch son of Zabbai a second measure, from the corner unto the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest.

familiar.text: After him Baruch the son of Zabbai earnestly repaired the other piece, from the turning of the wall unto the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest.

modern.text: Next to him, Baruch son of Zabbai diligently repaired another section, from the angle to the doorway of the house of Eliashib the high priest.

original.text: אַחֲרָ֨יו הֶחֱרָ֧ה הֶחֱזִ֛יק בָּר֥וּךְ בֶּן זבי מִדָּ֣ה שֵׁנִ֑ית מִן הַ֨מִּקְצ֔וֹעַ עַד פֶּ֨תַח֙ בֵּ֣ית אֶלְיָשִׁ֔יב הַכֹּהֵ֖ן הַגָּדֽוֹל

verses.restored: After him strengthened Meremoth son of Urijah son of Hakkoz a second measure, from the door of the house of Eliashib even to the end of the house of Eliashib.

familiar.text: After him repaired Meremoth the son of Urijah the son of Koz another piece, from the door of the house of Eliashib even to the end of the house of Eliashib.

modern.text: Next to him, Meremoth son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz, repaired another section, from the doorway of the house of Eliashib to the end of the house.

original.text: אַחֲרָ֣יו הֶחֱזִ֗יק מְרֵמ֧וֹת בֶּן אוּרִיָּ֛ה בֶּן הַקּ֖וֹץ מִדָּ֣ה שֵׁנִ֑ית מִפֶּ֨תַח֙ בֵּ֣ית אֶלְיָשִׁ֔יב וְעַד תַּכְלִ֖ית בֵּ֥ית אֶלְיָשִֽׁיב

verses.restored: And after him strengthened the priests, the men of the plain.

familiar.text: And after him repaired the priests, the men of the plain.

modern.text: And next to him, the priests from the surrounding area made repairs.

original.text: וְאַחֲרָ֛יו הֶחֱזִ֥יקוּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים אַנְשֵׁ֥י הַכִּכָּֽר

verses.restored: After him strengthened Benjamin and Hashub over against their house. After him strengthened Azariah son of Maaseiah son of Ananiah beside his house.

familiar.text: After him repaired Benjamin and Hashub over against their house. After him repaired Azariah the son of Maaseiah the son of Ananiah by his house.

modern.text: Beyond them, Benjamin and Hasshub made repairs in front of their house, and next to them, Azariah son of Maaseiah, the son of Ananiah, made repairs beside his house.

modern.text: After him, Binnui son of Henadad repaired another section, from the house of Azariah to the angle and the corner,

modern.text: And next to them, the Tekoites repaired another section, from a point opposite the great tower that juts out to the wall of Ophel.

original.text: אַחֲרָ֛יו הֶחֱזִ֥יקוּ הַתְּקֹעִ֖ים מִדָּ֣ה שֵׁנִ֑ית מִנֶּ֜גֶד הַמִּגְדָּ֤ל הַגָּדוֹל֙ הַיּוֹצֵ֔א וְעַ֖ד חוֹמַ֥ת הָעֹֽפֶל

verses.restored: From above the horse gate strengthened the priests, each one over against his house.

modern.text: Above the Horse Gate, each of the priests made repairs in front of his own house.

verses.restored: After him strengthened Zadok son of Immer over against his house. And after him strengthened Shemaiah son of Shechaniah, keeper of the east gate.

modern.text: Next to them, Zadok son of Immer made repairs opposite his house, and next to him, Shemaiah son of Shecaniah, the guard of the East Gate, made repairs.

original.text: אַחֲרָ֧יו הֶחֱזִ֛יק צָד֥וֹק בֶּן אִמֵּ֖ר נֶ֣גֶד בֵּית֑וֹ וְאַחֲרָ֤יו הֶחֱזִיק֙ שְׁמַֽעְיָ֣ה בֶן שְׁכַנְיָ֔ה שֹׁמֵ֖ר שַׁ֥עַר הַמִּזְרָֽח

familiar.text: After him repaired Hananiah the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph, another piece. After him repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah over against his chamber.

modern.text: Next to him, Hananiah son of Shelemiah, as well as Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph, repaired another section. Next to them, Meshullam son of Berechiah made repairs opposite his own quarters.

original.text: אחרי הֶחֱזִ֜יק חֲנַנְיָ֣ה בֶן שֶׁלֶמְיָ֗ה וְחָנ֧וּן בֶּן צָלָ֛ף הַשִּׁשִּׁ֖י מִדָּ֣ה שֵׁנִ֑י אַחֲרָ֣יו הֶחֱזִ֗יק מְשֻׁלָּם֙ בֶּן בֶּ֣רֶכְיָ֔ה נֶ֖גֶד נִשְׁכָּתֽוֹ

verses.restored: After him strengthened Malchijah son of the goldsmith, unto the place of the Nethinims and of the merchants, over against the gate Miphkad, and unto the ascent of the corner.

familiar.text: After him repaired Malchiah the goldsmith’s son unto the place of the Nethinims, and of the merchants, over against the gate Miphkad, and to the going up of the corner.

modern.text: Next to him, Malchijah, one of the goldsmiths, made repairs as far as the house of the temple servants and the merchants, opposite the Inspection Gate, and as far as the upper room above the corner.

original.text: אחרי הֶחֱזִ֗יק מַלְכִּיָּה֙ בֶּן הַצֹּ֣רְפִ֔י עַד בֵּ֥ית הַנְּתִינִ֖ים וְהָרֹכְלִ֑ים נֶ֚גֶד שַׁ֣עַר הַמִּפְקָ֔ד וְעַ֖ד עֲלִיַּ֥ת הַפִּנָּֽה

verses.restored: And between the ascent of the corner and the sheep gate strengthened the goldsmiths and the merchants.

familiar.text: And between the going up of the corner unto the sheep gate repaired the goldsmiths and the merchants.

modern.text: And between the upper room above the corner and the Sheep Gate, the goldsmiths and merchants made repairs.

original.text: וּבֵ֨ין עֲלִיַּ֤ת הַפִּנָּה֙ לְשַׁ֣עַר הַצֹּ֔אן הֶחֱזִ֥יקוּ הַצֹּרְפִ֖ים וְהָרֹכְלִֽים

translation_notes: This chapter lists workers on Jerusalem's post-exilic wall, organized by gate and section. Geographic markers (gates, towers, pools, royal property) reflect Persian-period topography.
Formula 'וְעַל־יָדוֹ חִזֵּק' ('and upon his hand strengthened' or 'next to him repaired') structures the list; repetition and rhythm are intentional.
Proper names are transliterated; some genealogies appear fragmentary, possibly reflecting incomplete or corrupt transmission.
Place names (Jericho, Tekoa, Gibeon, Mizpah, Keilah, Beth-zur, Ophel) indicate regional participation in wall reconstruction.
source_witness_audit_flags: verse 15: MT reads ויטללנו (ויעמידו bracketed); KJV 'covered it' from one reading, 'set up' from another—witness check needed
verse 20: MT name possibly Zaccai/Zebai; textual instability in patronymic—early versions vary
verse 30: MT parenthetical note suggests variant reading (אחרי vs אחרים); KJV numbering 'sixth' may reflect emendation
